evals.prompt: Audit the supplied repository instruction system. Do not modify it.
evals.expected_output: A snapshot-bound, read-only audit of the effective broad and local surfaces with evidence-backed findings.
assertions: The audit binds the declared harness contract, canonical sources, scopes, and representative working locations.
It identifies duplicate procedure, wrong-layer command, weak route, and projection drift with exact evidence.
It protects the useful migration route instead of recommending removal merely to reduce length.
No source or projection is modified.

evals.prompt: Audit and remediate the supplied repository instruction system, then verify the result.
evals.expected_output: A preserved pre-change audit, an authoring revision of canonical sources, reconciliation, and a post-change closure matrix.
assertions: The response preserves pre-change source identities and findings before mutation.
Remediation uses the author-agent-instructions workflow and changes canonical sources rather than aliases.
Affected and adjacent entry points are retested after reconciliation.
The final pass is labeled closure verification rather than independent approval.

evals.prompt: Audit which instruction wins for the conflicting task in this fixture.
evals.expected_output: An Inconclusive precedence finding because the host contract is unavailable, without guessing that the narrower file wins.
assertions: Scope, applicability, composition, and precedence are treated as distinct questions.
Directory proximity is not treated as proof of runtime precedence.
The report identifies the missing host evidence and recommends removing the conflict until behavior is authoritative.
